annotations.title: What Offsite Ads cost on Etsy, and the price that covers it

description: Works out what Etsy's Offsite Ads cost a shop at its share of sales (12% or 15% of an attributed order, at most $100 an order), per order and per month, and the item price that covers the fee. It fits a seller who asks what Offsite Ads cost them, whether to price them in, or whether to opt out. Takes the item price, shipping charged, the shop's Offsite Ads rate (12-percent past $10,000, 15-percent under, or off), orders a month, and the share of sales from Offsite Ads if the seller knows it (else 10%, the figure Etsy gave at launch in 2020, flagged as a default). Materials and label cost are optional and add how far orders could fall before the price rise leaves the seller worse off. Returns the fee per attributed order and on average, the monthly and yearly cost, the price fix and its value if orders hold, and when opting out is possible. US dollars; dated Etsy rules with sources. Free, no sign-in. Takes numbers only; nothing is stored.

itemPrice.description: Typical item price, US dollars, before shipping.

labelCost.description: Optional: the shipping label, US dollars.

materials.description: Optional: materials per item, US dollars. With labelCost, adds how far orders could fall before the price fix leaves the seller worse off.

offsiteAds.description: The shop's Offsite Ads rate: 12-percent (the shop has sold $10,000 or more in any 12 months; for life, no opt-out), 15-percent (under $10,000, Offsite Ads on), or off (opted out). none is taken as off.

offsiteShare.description: Share of sales from Offsite Ads (Marketing > Offsite Ads): a fraction (0.1 is 10%), or a band. Left out: 10%, the figure Etsy gave at launch in 2020, flagged as a default.

orders.description: Orders in a typical month: a number from 1 to 100,000 (Shop Manager > Stats > Orders), or a band. Over 300: send the number.

packaging.description: Packaging per order in US dollars, or mailer (about $1), box (about $3) or not-sure. Left out: $1, a weakly sourced typical figure, flagged as a default.

shippingCharged.description: What the buyer pays for shipping, US dollars (0 if free). Offsite Ads are charged on it too.

name: sellerprofit_offsite_ads

isDefault.description: True when the value isn't the seller's own number or tap: a default their own figure would replace.

averagePerOrder.description: The fee spread over every order: share × fee.

link.description: Opens the matching page on sellerprofitdoctor.com. Carries none of the figures sent.

optOut.description: Opting out is possible only under $10,000. A test, not a verdict.

monthly.description: What pricing it in keeps a month, if orders hold.

priceFix.description: The item price that covers the Offsite Ads fee; null when there's no fee.

rate.description: The fee on an attributed order: 0.12, 0.15, or 0 when off.

rates.description: Which rules the numbers use, as of when, and where they come from.

asOf.description: The day the platform's fee table was last checked against its sources (YYYY-MM-DD).

estimatesLine.description: Amazon only: which rates are third-party estimates (FBA, storage, returns and the rest sit behind the Seller Central login). Say so when citing them.

recheckBy.description: The day the table is due for its next check.

share.description: Share of sales from Offsite Ads used.
